title: Determinant-one real Möbius maps preserve pseudohyperbolic disks
statement: Define D(v,ε)={z∈ℂ : Im(z)>0 and ‖(z−v)/(z−conj(v))‖≤ε}. Let v∈ℂ and ε∈ℝ satisfy Im(v)>0 and 0<ε<1. Let a,b,c,d∈ℝ satisfy ad−bc=1, and define the total complex function M(z)=(az+b)/(cz+d). Then M(D(v,ε))=D(M(v),ε), where M(D(v,ε)) denotes the set-theoretic image.
lean_statement: let D : ℂ → ℝ → Set ℂ := fun v ε => {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im ∧ ‖(z - v) / (z - star v)‖ ≤ ε}; ∀ (v : ℂ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < v.im → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → ∀ a b c d : ℝ, a * d - b * c = 1 → let M : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((a : ℂ) * z + (b : ℂ)) / ((c : ℂ) * z + (d : ℂ)); M '' (D v ε) = D (M v) ε
